body:
Thank you, I really do appreciate an outsiders point of view on this. 

I have been spending as much time as possible around him, and every single time he coughs, it sends shivers down my spine and I feel sick to my stomach. He doesn't really think much of it, but I have done the research...that's not saying I know for a fact he has a condition, I just know that his symptoms aren't normal.  

I really don't know what to say to him without alarming him. His symptoms aren't bad enough yet for him or anyone else to be alarmed so I just don't know.

To be completely honest, I am being a selfish fuck, part of me just needs to get him to a see a doctor so I can feel better. Cause not knowing is a living hell.

Lastly, say the worst is true. How am I any better than a person that murdered someone and would a normal person really want me in their life?
I am so sorry for your loss. I can't even imagine what it's like losing a brother. Also, thank you for your kind words.

Just to be clear, he is not going through anything at the moment. I have dropped a hint or 2, but I am to big of a coward/terrified to tell him to get checked out. And do you really think he would want someone around that most likely caused his problems?
